scenario: `after` timer does NOT fire before the delay per LTAC.9.1. Advance clock by 3_s when delay is 5_s: timer has not fired, Delayed fact not yet in WM. The body emits a `ttl` Delayed because a `logical` emit in an `after` body is refused ([LLOG.11.9]).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Delayed scope ttl 1_h:
    dummy: Int

rule delayed:
    Trig
->
    log info "start"
    after 5_s:
        emit Delayed dummy: 0
